Reliance Industries Responds to Starlink Competition Row

Reliance Industries has stated it welcomes competition, including from Starlink, and "has never feared competition." The company emphasized that all satellite communication providers must adhere to Indian laws and policies. Reliance noted that its own satellite services are awaiting government clearances. The statement comes amid a controversy surrounding Starlink's potential entry into the Indian market and questions raised by Elon Musk regarding delays.
